subject: Physics
front_prompt: Define path length (distance) in one-dimensional motion.
back_answer: The total length of the path traversed by an object in a given time interval during its motion in a straight line.

subject: Physics
back_answer: The change in position of an object in a given direction, defined as the vector difference between its final position and initial position.

subject: Physics
front_prompt: Distinguish between average speed and average velocity.
back_answer: Average speed is the total path length divided by the total time elapsed (scalar), while average velocity is the total displacement divided by the total time elapsed (vector).

subject: Physics
front_prompt: How is instantaneous velocity defined mathematically?
back_answer: Instantaneous velocity is the limit of the average velocity as the time interval delta t approaches zero, given by v = dx/dt.

subject: Physics
front_prompt: What does the slope of a position-time (x-t) graph represent?
back_answer: The slope of a position-time graph at any point represents the instantaneous velocity of the object at that instant.

subject: Physics
front_prompt: What does the area under a velocity-time (v-t) graph represent?
back_answer: The area under a velocity-time graph between two time instants represents the displacement of the object during that time interval.

subject: Physics

subject: Physics
front_prompt: What is relative velocity in one dimension?
back_answer: The velocity of object A relative to object B, denoted as v_AB, is defined as the vector difference between their velocities: v_AB = v_A - v_B.
